messages:
Priya (PR): Heads up — final QA found a discrepancy in the benchmark blog's executive blurb. The summary claims ~18% cost reduction but the calculated table shows ~14%. Holding publish.

Alex P: Thanks. is this a computation error or copy mismatch?

Maria L: Looks like copy mismatch. The PR draft had older numbers.

Jordan C: Are the PNG/figures impacted?

Sanjay R: Charts are fine; underlying numbers all use 14%. It's the lead sentence only.

Priya (PR): Ok pause newsletter, social, and any embargo sends. I'll hold the press outreach.

press-bot: Scheduled newsletter at 2026-12-02T13:00:00Z cancelled by Priya.

Alex P: Great. Can we update the sentence and re-run the preview quickly?

Maria L: I'll patch the markdown and run link/spell checks. ETA 15m.

Jordan C: If you want, I can also regenerate the HTML preview and screenshots.

Sanjay R: I'll add a tiny correction note to the post metadata: "Correction (Dec 2): Executive summary corrected from ~18% to ~14%."

Legal Bot: No legal review required for alignment fixes. Please include the change in commit message for audit trail.

Priya (PR): Once staged, I'll resend embargo with the changelog and call out to press contacts. Keep all local copies of assets deleted until the resend goes out.

Jordan C: Pushed changes to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/blog/benchmarks-draft

Maria L: Preview looks good. Updated the caption for the featured image too.

press-bot: Embargoed preview re-sent to journalists by Priya at 2026-12-02T13:22:00Z

Priya (PR): Sent. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you confirm assets are matching.

Jordan C: Confirmed. :white_check_mark:

Maria L: Confirmed.

Alex P: Closing thread. We'll add a pre-publish checklist item to avoid this going forward.
